teaser.en: The Digo say this spiny wild asparagus is strong enough to fell an elephant.
teaser.sw: Wadigo husema asparagasi huu wa porini wenye miiba una nguvu za kuweza kumwangusha tembo.

summary.en: *Mwinika ndzovu* is a spiny woody climber, a wild asparagus with sickle-shaped 'leaves' and small white flowers. It is regarded as a strong medicine.
summary.sw: *Mwinika ndzovu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu na miiba, asparagasi wa porini mwenye 'majani' yaliyopinda kama mundu na maua madogo meupe. Huhesabiwa kuwa dawa yenye nguvu.

about.en:
*Mwinika ndzovu* is a woody, spiny climber that can scramble high into trees. What look like leaves are actually flattened green stems, curved like small sickles, which gives it its English name.

The small white flowers are sweetly scented and appear in clusters along the stems. The sharp, hooked spines catch on clothing and make the plant easy to remember.
about.sw:
*Mwinika ndzovu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu na miiba unaoweza kutambaa juu sana mitini. Kinachoonekana kama majani kwa kweli ni mashina bapa ya kijani, yaliyopinda kama miundu midogo, na ndiko jina lake la Kiingereza linakotoka.

Maua madogo meupe yana harufu tamu na huchanua katika vishada kando ya mashina. Miiba mikali iliyopinda kama ndoano hunasa nguo na kuufanya mmea huu kuwa rahisi kukumbukwa.

where.en: Look for *mwinika ndzovu* in bushland and on forest edges, climbing over shrubs and trees.
where.sw: Mtafute *mwinika ndzovu* vichakani na kando ya misitu, ukipanda juu ya vichaka na miti.

uses.en: *Mwinika ndzovu* is regarded as a strong medicine.
uses.sw: *Mwinika ndzovu* huhesabiwa kuwa dawa yenye nguvu.

culture.en: *Mwinika* is the Digo collective name for all the wild asparagus plants. Adding *ndzovu*, 'elephant', marks this one as strong enough to fell an elephant, a measure of its reputation as medicine.
culture.sw: *Mwinika* ni jina la jumla la Kidigo kwa mimea yote ya asparagasi wa porini. Kuongeza *ndzovu*, 'tembo', kunauonyesha huu kuwa na nguvu za kuweza kumwangusha tembo, kipimo cha sifa yake kama dawa.

names.en: Digo: *mwinika ndzovu*, a name shared with Duruma and Swahili. *Mwinika* is the general name for asparagus plants, and *ndzovu* means 'elephant'. English: sickle-thorn asparagus. Scientists call it *Asparagus falcatus*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mwinika ndzovu*, jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kiswahili. *Mwinika* ni jina la jumla la mimea ya asparagasi, na *ndzovu* linamaanisha 'tembo'. Kwa Kiingereza: *sickle-thorn asparagus*. Wanasayansi huuita *Asparagus falcatus*.

reason.sw: Chongwa, katika familia moja ya mimea
